title: Hedge-failure case catalogue: the Phase C acceptance list
source: Built in Phase 0 (5 Nov 2026) from hedge_failure_study_report (HS), hedge_failure_deep_dive_report (HD), lifecycle_realism_report (LR), perp_lifecycle_report (PL), perp_mechanics_report (PM). Code and tests are as of the phase0-gate tag.
how_to_read: Each case lists where the backtester and the core handle it today, with the tests that pin it, and the scenario in tests/test_integration_scenarios.py (S1-S19) or the existing test that covers it. A test prefixed with ~ is related, not a direct test. Test names were checked to exist, not to cover the claim: treat the list as the Phase C acceptance list to confirm, case by case, when each is run through the core path with the old result shown beside it. Decisions (5 Nov): unwind band stays 15 bps in v1.1 and becomes one core setting labelled DECISION_PENDING_CALIBRATION in Phase C; the 5 s breaker rule and the 30 s residual-breach rule stay separate settings, evidence from the fault runs goes to Phase E.
